Beginning to take effect shortly (September) is a change to our CC permit and process in SD. Short version - it now mimics very closely ND requirements. Long version...

[CITATION SATISFIED]

https://sdsos.gov/services-for-individuals/concealed-pistol-permits/default.aspx

https://legiscan.com/SD/bill/HB1215/2015

http://dci.sd.gov/LawEnforcementTraining/EnhancedConcealedPistolUseofForceTraining.aspx

WHAT DOES NOT CHANGE

Current permits. 10 bucks at the sheriff office for them to Google you and give you a laminate card with your name on it so you can carry in SD and where reciprocity currently exists for the permit.

WHAT DOES CHANGE

There is now an enhanced permit available starting September. It will be used to establish reciprocity in tougher (read: gaaaaaaaaay) states where there are other requirements listed here.

Q: What is required to get this permit where I can go more places?

A: You attend a course that is being developed by the state of South Dakota currently that includes

-A fee not to exceed $150 (which will likely be the standard fee)

-98 rounds of live fire

-Basic laws of South Dakota relating to firearms

-Basic concepts of pistols and self defense

-FBI Fingerprinting (of course you have to pay for it, silly!)

Q: What if I want to be an instructor for these permit courses?

A: Be an NRA pistol instructor (they won't even look at you otherwise) and then pay $150 to the state of SD and go to Pierre for training. As of the end of September there will be only 20 in the state. Then you can set up courses and do stuff.
IMPORTANT if you are a CCL holder
